detail: Compiled public statistics for Nepal August 2026 flash flood, for analysis/POC. Not an official NDRRMA release.
NDRRMA / Nepal Police 20 Sep 2026: 1,451 dead; 5,786 missing (636 foreign); 13,784 rescued
7,570 houses damaged; 8,317 households / 32,963 people in 5 districts
Nuwakot 52.5% of damaged buildings; Bidur 3,026 buildings
84,270 people / 19,284 HH; NPR 200 billion infrastructure loss; 2,500 houses damaged in Nuwakot (as of 5 Sep)
